text.intro: Type an attack rating, a percent, a defence and the two levels; the table walks the chance to hit step by step. The numbers offered first are illustrative.

steps.swap: Swaps when one side is negative
steps.roll: A roll of 0 to 99 hits when it is below the chance

calc.swapDef: defence below 0: it is added to the attack rating and the defence is 0
calc.swapAr: attack rating below 0: it is added to the defence and the attack rating is 0
calc.swapBoth: both: the defence below 0 is added to the attack rating, which is still below 0 and is then added to the defence; the attack rating is 0
calc.first: 100 x AR / (AR + DEF), 100 when both are 0
calc.level: chance x attacker level x 2 / (attacker level + defender level)

text.note: Computed by our model of the hit test, not observed in the game. The hit chance is one draw on the attacker's seed; the draw itself is not shown here, nor how the attack rating, its percent and the defence are made up.
